case: date[] result, CSV and SQL replay across DateStyle configurations
contract: The server session begins with DateStyle SQL, DMY; its raw date[] text uses DMY while the driver result remains canonical ISO array text for BC, finite, infinity and SQL NULL elements.
Native pg_typeof, array_to_json and array_send provide independent type, semantic-value and wire-byte oracles.
The result is rebound and SQL-file replayed after changing the transaction to ISO, MDY; the restored array_send bytes match the source.
CSV export retains the canonical ISO array literal across the DateStyle transition.
